extracted.intended_audience: public relations, marketing, and communications professionals or organizations seeking press release distribution
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for distributing press releases using a commercial newswire service (PR Newswire): steps for submission, targeting, adding multimedia, editorial review, and tracking results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unparalleled reach / network size
rubrics_metrics.description: PR Newswire claims the largest reach with a network of 82k+ media & press release syndication outlets and 300k+ journalists & influencers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the service to maximize visibility and engagement through its broad network of outlets and journalists; the network size is presented as a primary reason to choose the distributor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extensive breadth and depth of targeting
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to distribute to 170+ countries, 40+ languages, 200+ beats & verticals, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select how specifically or broadly to distribute by choosing from accurate, comprehensive, and inclusive targeting lists (locations, industries, verticals, beats, demographics). Tailor distribution to the desired audience reach and relevance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sourcing / media pickup
rubrics_metrics.description: PR Newswire reports 135M+ annual links to PR Newswire press releases from media and related websites.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use syndication and tracking metrics to evaluate likely pickup and third-party linking; the large number of annual links is presented as evidence of widespread distribution and pickup.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data security and compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Data security measures include multi-factor authentication and verification, with SOC 2 Type II Privacy & Security compliance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose distribution services that provide strong security controls and compliance assurances for account and content protection.

rubrics_metrics.name: 24/7/365 editorial team support
rubrics_metrics.description: An editorial team is available at any time to review releases, advise on improvements, and distribute them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage editorial support for quality control and distribution advice; availability around the clock is emphasized as a service differentiator.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution accuracy / error rate
rubrics_metrics.description: PR Newswire states a 99.8% error-free distribution rate; they review and distribute 325k+ releases annually and catch 17.5k+ mistakes prior to publishing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rely on the provider's quality-control processes to minimize distribution errors; these metrics can be used to compare vendors' reliability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Upload and editorial review (proofreading, links, tagging, SEO)
rubrics_metrics.description: When you submit your news release it is sent to industry experts who proofread every release, look for broken links, ensure proper tagging, and provide SEO-related content best practices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before distribution, use the editorial review to correct errors, fix links, apply correct tagging, and implement recommended SEO best practices for immediate and long-term search performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience targeting selection (specificity control)
rubrics_metrics.description: Decide how specifically or broadly you want to distribute your press release by selecting from targeting lists (locations, industries, verticals, beats such as small business or regulatory compliance, demographics).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Carefully choose the level of specificity to balance reach with relevance; use beats and verticals to reach more relevant journalists and outlets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include multimedia to increase engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Press releases that include multimedia receive up to 6x greater engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Embed photos, videos, logos, infographics, and other dynamic content in releases to substantially boost engagement; the platform supports easy multimedia inclusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Send and track results with Visibility Report
rubrics_metrics.description: A complimentary Visibility Report provides press release analytics: online pickup, traffic, audience data, engagement activity, and other key metrics for every release sent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Visibility Report to measure impact, understand which outlets and audiences engaged, and inform future targeting and content decisions.
